description: prioritetinių duomenų rinkinys (as-is) - Lietuvos Respublikos nustatytų pagrindinių kelių, geležinkelių, oro uostų ir aglomeracijų ruožų vieta is a dataset listed in Geoportal of Lithuania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire-geoportal.lt. Major roads, major railways,major airports and agglomerations designated by MS • Per agglomeration ≥ 100,000 inhabitants • For overall major roads ≥ 3 million vehicles per year • For overall major railways ≥ 30,000 trains per year • For major airports ≥ 50,000 air traffic movements per year Delivery process is managed by EEA. Coverage: LT. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE Priority Data Set (as-is) - Location of major roads, railways, airports and agglomerations sections designated b" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-lt.
